schema_validation.method: dependency-free deterministic conformance checks for the submission schema

human_review_reasons: CHK1 has no independent declared curriculum credit total.
CHK4 has no separate placement-credit and course-description-credit fields.
CHK5 has flexible prerequisite/co-requisite cases without requirement_type.
CHK6 has no alternative-group metadata for repeated placeholder slots.
CHK7 has source-listed fixed normal semesters outside 9-22 credits; no automatic credit exception is applied and human/source review is required.

CHK1.description: Plan total credits equal the declared curriculum credits.

findings.detail: No independent declared curriculum or plan credit total exists in curriculum.json; total_courses is not a credit total.

CHK2.description: Every actual numeric course code has a non-empty desc_th or desc_en when a description is present in the artifact.

exceptions.detail: Records without both description fields are reported as exceptions because curriculum.json does not provide an independent description source for them.

CHK3.description: Every ordinary course code is exactly 8 ASCII numeric digits; source placeholders and explicit alternative groups are reported as Lab exceptions.

exceptions.reason: The literal Thai OR label denotes one alternative-course group record; it is not treated as an ordinary malformed code.
The literal Thai OR label denotes one alternative-course group record; it is not treated as an ordinary malformed code.

evidence.alternative_group_detection: course code contains Thai OR (หรือ) and at least two exact 8-digit mentions

CHK4.description: Credits in a plan placement agree with the corresponding course description record.

findings.detail: curriculum.json stores one credits field inside each course object and has no separate course-description record or placement-credit field to compare.

CHK5.description: An explicitly coded prerequisite is scheduled earlier than its dependent course, allowing same-semester co-requisites only when the relationship is known.

exceptions.reason: The prerequisite itself has flexible timing; strict ordering cannot be established.
The prerequisite itself has flexible timing; strict ordering cannot be established.
At least one flexible dependent term is the same semester as the prerequisite; requirement_type is absent, so co-requisite status cannot be confirmed.
The prerequisite itself has flexible timing; strict ordering cannot be established.
The prerequisite itself has flexible timing; strict ordering cannot be established.

evidence.prerequisite_extraction: unique ASCII [0-9]{8} mentions in prerequisite text
evidence.flexible_order_rule: all listed flexible terms must be later than a fixed prerequisite to pass
evidence.co_requisite_policy: same-semester cases remain exceptions when requirement_type is absent

CHK6.description: No duplicate course placement occurs in the same plan and semester; alternatives count once only when alternative metadata identifies them.

exceptions.reason: The artifact has no alternative-group metadata, so repeated placeholder slots cannot be distinguished from duplicate placements deterministically.
The artifact has no alternative-group metadata, so repeated placeholder slots cannot be distinguished from duplicate placements deterministically.

evidence.extraction_duplicate_policy: Exact value-identical records are diagnosed as merge duplicates but are not patched.

CHK7.description: Normal fixed semesters are checked against 9-22 credits; source-listed out-of-range totals without a deterministic exclusion are recorded as source-condition/human-review exceptions.

evidence.alternative_group_policy: An explicit OR group is one source record and is counted once; no synthetic alternatives are added.
